technical.zh-CN: 具身双臂采用双七自由度及主从双向力反馈，面向动作和力控数据采集；该产品与不依赖生物电信号的下肢外骨骼是不同技术路线。
technical.en: The embodied dual-arm system uses two seven-degree-of-freedom arms and bilateral master-slave force feedback for motion/force data collection. It is distinct from the lower-limb exoskeleton that does not use bioelectric signals.
